name: tabs
title: Tabs
summary: Switch between views that share one place.
description: Switch between views that share one place. A row of 13px tab labels; the selected one sits on a filled pill (pill) or over an ink underline (underline), or is a surface of its own joined to the panel or toolbar below (attached: browser and editor tabs), and that indicator slides to the next tab under the pointer and jumps under the keyboard. Panels swap instantly. One tab stop: arrow keys move and select. Tabs can be closable (open files, browser tabs): a close button beside each trigger, Delete on the focused tab, focus and selection handed to a neighbour. A strip with more tabs than room scrolls sideways and keeps the selected tab in view; `fill` makes the panel take the height of its container. Behaviour, focus and ARIA come from the Zag tabs machine, through Ark UI in React, Vue and Svelte.

anatomy.description: data-orientation (set by the engine). With fill: the height of its container (which must have one).

Optional. The host's header row around the list (headerClass adds the host's class), holding the host's trailing parts after the list (the end slot). Rendered only when headerClass or end is given. A flex row; with inHeader the list fills its height.

role=tablist; the indicator's offset parent. Scrolls sideways when the tabs do not fit (no scrollbar, the wheel's sideways overscroll stays in): the selected tab is kept in view, 24px clear of the edge so the next one peeks in.

The engine's indicator: given the selected tab's box as --left / --top / --width / --height, it travels on transform only while a pointer selection is made; hidden until measured. Pill: field colour, radius.chip. Carries kbd-instant.

Only around a closable tab: the trigger and its close button side by side (a button cannot hold a button). Not positioned, so the trigger's offset box stays the list's (the indicator measures the trigger, which keeps room at its end for the close button, so the pill or the underline spans both).
role=tab; aria-selected, data-selected, data-disabled. Holds the label part.
An item's icon before its label: a file icon (an icon element / component, data-slot="icon") or a favicon (an image URL, drawn as an ). aria-hidden: the label names the tab. 16px (14px at xs and sm).
The tab's text on one line; it truncates at the end and carries the full text as title.

A closable tab's close button: 16px with a 24px target, pulled back over the trigger's end room. Shown on the selected tab and while its tab is hovered (always on touch); keeps its room at rest, so the strip never reflows. Not a tab stop (the keyboard closes with Delete on the tab, aria-keyshortcuts) but not hidden either: named "Close <tab>", reachable by a screen reader's cursor and by touch exploration. A press never takes focus.
role=tabpanel; hidden unless its tab is selected. With fill: takes the height the strip leaves and scrolls inside itself (put a ScrollArea with h-full in it for the system's scrollbar).

items.label: string
items.icon: icon element or component | image URL (favicon)?

items.description: Tabs in order, each with its panel content. Strings are accepted as value = label.

value.description: Selected tab. Defaults to the first enabled tab.

variant.description: pill: the selected tab sits on a filled pill (the chat header strip). underline: an ink bar under the selected tab on a hairline. attached: browser and editor tabs (Chrome, VS Code). The selected tab is a surface of its own, the colour of the panel or toolbar under it (--fndn-tabs-surface on the Tabs or an ancestor; default color.surface), with rounded top corners and inverse curves at its feet, and it joins what is below (no line under it); its panel takes the same surface. The other tabs sit on the strip (the host's colour, one step darker than the surface), ink-2, with a hairline between them hidden beside the selected and the hovered tab; hover fills half the surface. No travelling indicator and no press scale: a joined tab is selected in place. Attached tabs share the strip as Chrome's do: 240px at most each, shrinking together to 96px before the strip scrolls; a label cut by that keeps its full text in the title.

size.description: xs 24 · sm 28: dense strips (an editor's file tabs, a browser's tabs), 12px labels, 14px icons; md (default) keeps each variant's height (pill 26, underline 32, attached 32). Dimensions only.

inHeader.description: pill or underline, for a strip inside a card header (a code block's file tabs, an editor's panel strip). The list fills the header's height (underline tabs stretch to it) and draws no hairline of its own: the header's bottom line is the line, and the underline rests on it. Its own prop, not a size: the size scale is dimensions only.

headerProps.description: Attributes for the header row, so a host can mark it as its own part (code-block: data-code-block="header").

headerClass.description: Wraps the list in the header part with this class added (the host's header row, e.g. a code block's header).

closable.description: Every tab gets a close button and closes on Delete (an item's own `closable` wins): open files, browser tabs, documents. The Tabs never remove a tab themselves: they select the neighbour and emit close; the caller removes the item.

closeLabel.description: Verb of a close button's name, followed by the tab's text ("Close rate-limit.ts").

fill.description: The root takes the height of its container and the selected panel the rest (an editor's bottom panel, a pane). A variant, so hosts never reach into the panel with selectors.

tabSizing.description: attached only. shrink (Chrome): tabs share the strip, 240px at most each, and shrink together to 96px before the strip scrolls; labels are cut at their end with a title. fit (VS Code): each tab is as wide as its title, never cut, and the strip scrolls sideways (the selected tab is kept in view). Use fit for files whose names differ only at the end (rate-limit.ts, rate-limit.test.ts).

slots.panel: Content of a panel (Vue slot / Svelte snippet, called with the item). In React an item's `content` may be a node.
slots.end: Parts after the list inside the header part (a path, a copy button); implies the header part.

events.close: (value: string) when a closable tab asks to close (its button, or Delete / Backspace on it). If it was selected, valueChange has already moved the selection to the next enabled tab, else the previous. attached, closed by the pointer: emitted once the tab's room has closed (duration.reveal later); from the keyboard and under reduced motion at once.

keyboard: Tab reaches the selected tab; the list is one tab stop, the next Tab goes to the panel
ArrowRight / ArrowLeft move to the next / previous enabled tab and select it (selection follows focus); they wrap
Home / End move to the first / last enabled tab and select it

Delete (and Backspace, the key macOS labels delete) closes the focused closable tab; focus and selection move to the next enabled tab, else the previous. The browser keeps Ctrl/⌘ W, so the platform's own close shortcut cannot be taken by a web page
notes: Give the list an aria-label when nothing else names it.
A selection made from the keyboard moves the indicator instantly; the slide is for the pointer. Panels never animate.
A truncated label keeps its full text in the title; the accessible name is the full text either way.
To select from outside, control `value`: React value / onValueChange, Vue v-model:value, Svelte bind:value.

A closable trigger carries aria-keyshortcuts="Delete"; its close button is not a tab stop (the Tab key meets only tabs) but it is not hidden: it is named "Close <tab>" (closeLabel + the tab's text), so a screen reader's cursor and touch exploration (VoiceOver, TalkBack) reach and press it; Delete keeps working on the focused tab.
When the selected tab moves out of a scrolling strip it is scrolled back into view: instantly after a key, smoothly after a click.
An item's icon is decoration (aria-hidden; a favicon is an ): the label is the tab's name.

motion: indicator: transform and width over duration.move with easing.move, only for a pointer selection; no slide on mount, none on resize, instant under the keyboard; on the selected tab from the first paint (the adapters place it before the engine measures; until then the selected tab paints the same pill itself and hands over at once)
tab label: colour over duration.base, ease: ink-2 at rest, ink on hover, ink when selected (both variants; no opacity); instant under the keyboard
press: the tab scales to motion.press-scale over duration.press
close button: fades in on hover of its tab (opacity over duration.fast); background over duration.fast; press scales to motion.press-scale from the pointer only
strip scroll: smooth to the selected tab after a pointer selection, instant after a key or under reduced motion

attached: no indicator and no press scale (the tab is joined to the panel); the selected surface changes at once, only the label's ink fades over duration.base; the hover fill and the hairlines between tabs change at once; instant under the keyboard

closing: pill and underline, and attached from the keyboard: instant (the tab goes, its neighbours close the gap in one frame, the indicator lands on the neighbour). attached from the pointer: the tab's room closes (width, min-width and inline padding to 0 over duration.reveal, easing.out-strong) while it fades (opacity over duration.base) and takes no presses; close is emitted when the room has closed (duration.reveal later; at once under reduced motion). The selection and focus move to the neighbour at once

arrival (attached): a tab added after the first paint opens its room from 0 (width, min-width, inline padding over duration.reveal, easing.out-strong) while it fades in over duration.base, so the + button and the tabs after it move instead of jumping; nothing plays on the first paint (the adapters set ready two frames after mount); instant when the keyboard was last used; under reduced motion only the fade. fit tabs (width auto) move through interpolate-size: in browsers without it they appear at once
